title: festuca rubra f. lasiolepis
intro: Festuca rubra f. lasiolepis, commonly known as red fescue, is a type of grass species that belongs to the family Poaceae. This perennial grass is known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca rubra f. lasiolepis include wound healing, skin protection, and the treatment of various inflammatory conditions due to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Research has identified the bioactive constituents of Festuca rubra f. lasiolepis as responsible for its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
